papers.title: $\mu$SR measurements of 3D Ising ferromagnetism in bulk Fe$_3$GeTe$_2$ crystals
papers.authors: Wilson, M. N., Huang, J., Hicken, T. J., Mayoh, D. A., Huddart, B. M., Balakrishnan, G., Lancaster, T.
papers.institutions: 作者单位见 arXiv 原文；本轮未逐一归一化机构名称
papers.access: 全文精读：已读公开正文、实验/Methods 与关键图注；
papers.abstract: 作者说明使用 CVT 生长的块体 Fe₃GeTe₂，但已读 Methods 未列出输运剂、装料纯度、封管气氛、源端与生长端温区、保温时间、晶体大小和批次统计；这些参数均须标为正文未报告。μSR 在束流前放约 100 μm Ag degrader，使 μ 子平均停在约 200 μm 深处，降低仅由表面氧化造成信号的可能性。作者用 DFT 考察三个候选 μ 子位点，再联系内部场与自旋构型；停位是模型支持，不是直接拍到的原子位点。
papers.conclusion: 同一块块体 Fe₃GeTe₂ 在 220 K 以下直至 2 K 都保有三维 Ising 型铁磁；170 K 的磁化异常更可能是磁畴冻结，而不是先前猜测的铁磁转反铁磁。

sections.title: 问题与对照
sections.text: Fe₃GeTe₂ 是可剥离的铁磁金属，但块体材料在约 170 K 的第二异常究竟意味着新的反铁磁相，还是磁畴运动冻结，一直会影响对低温自旋响应的解释。这项工作刻意在同一块 CVT 晶体上比较宏观 SQUID 与体敏感零场 μSR，而不是从不同批次样品的两条曲线拼接相图。ZFCW/FCC 在 H∥c、100 Oe 条件下见到约 220 K 主转变和 170 K 的分叉；这只是直接磁化现象，单凭分叉不能给微观自旋排布定性。

sections.title: 样品与方法可复现性
sections.text: 作者说明使用 CVT 生长的块体 Fe₃GeTe₂，但已读 Methods 未列出输运剂、装料纯度、封管气氛、源端与生长端温区、保温时间、晶体大小和批次统计；这些参数均须标为正文未报告。μSR 在束流前放约 100 μm Ag degrader，使 μ 子平均停在约 200 μm 深处，降低仅由表面氧化造成信号的可能性。作者用 DFT 考察三个候选 μ 子位点，再联系内部场与自旋构型；停位是模型支持，不是直接拍到的原子位点。

sections.title: 证据链与替代解释
sections.text: 强证据是同晶体的整体磁化与局域内场在低温给出一致的铁磁延续图像，并且 μSR 的体敏感设计使表面副相解释较弱。零场信号快速退相干说明局域场分布宽；作者把低温数据与 3D Ising 型铁磁联系起来，但局域不均匀、Fe 空位和磁畴结构仍可改变线形。170 K 异常归为磁畴冻结是作者解释：若要把“未出现反铁磁转变”推到所有批次，必须对 Fe 非化学计量和结构堆垛做同晶体定量。

sections.title: 下一炉和阅读路线
sections.text: 建议先核 Methods 的 100 Oe 磁化几何与 μSR 穿透深度，再把 Fig.1 的 170/220 K 与 Fig.3–5 的频率、弛豫率同温比较。下一炉记录 Fe/Ge/Te 实测比例、晶体厚度、CVT 梯度、Laue/EDS、摇摆曲线以及堆垛缺陷。把同一母晶切成 SQUID、μSR 和显微结构样品，做 150–190 K 升降温/频率扫描。这个实验能区分可重复的体相转变与被钉扎磁畴，而不会把拟合优度直接当作新的磁相证据。

readingGuide.first: 先读 II Methods 的同晶体 SQUID/μSR 几何，再看 Fig.1 的 170/220 K 与 Fig.3–5 的 μ 子退相干。
readingGuide.focus: 作者把 100 Oe、H∥c 的 ZFCW/FCC 磁化曲线与同一晶体的零场 μSR 对照。μ 子停在约 200 μm 深处，减弱了表面氧化物解释；三个候选 μ 子位点由 DFT 求得。快速衰减的信号提示内部场分布宽，但不能单凭它确定层错类型或空间分布。

papers.title: Spectroscopic Evidence for Nontrivial Band Topology in Superconducting FeTe/MnTe Heterostructure
papers.authors: Su, Shiwu, Liang, Yu, Li, Tongrui, Wang, Zhen, Wang, Yuzhe, Li, Xianglin, Liao, Sen, Ran, Pengxu, Sun, Jiexiong, Cui, Shengtao, Sun, Zhe, Liu, Zhengtai, Liu, Jishan, Ye, Mao, Tao, Jing, Feng, Donglai, Jiang, Juan

papers.abstract: FeTe has long been regarded as a nonsuperconducting antiferromagnetic metal with trivial band topology, but recent advances in stoichiometry control have begun to challenge this picture. Here we use higher-order epitaxy on zinc-blende MnTe to stabilize near-stoichiometric FeTe with strongly suppressed interstitial Fe and a superconducting transition onset near 13 K. Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy reveals markedly enhanced quasiparticle coherence, well-defined Fe-derived hole bands, and a nearly two-dimensional Dirac-cone-like state near the Fermi level. First-principles calculations identify an inversion between odd- and even-parity bands, yielding nontrivial $Z_2$ topology and a Dirac surface state consistent with experiment. These results elucidate the intrinsic electronic structure of stoichiometric superconducting FeTe and provide evidence for nontrivial band topology, positioning FeTe/MnTe as a promising platform for exploring topological superconductivity.
papers.conclusion: 用 MnTe(111) 模板把 FeTe 推近 1:1 化学计量，超导起始约 13 K；相干能带和近费米能 Dirac 态出现，DFT 给出带反转与 Z₂=1。但拓扑超导仍是待验证假说。

papers.method: Czochralski；同步辐射 XRD；电阻/磁化/DSC
papers.abstract: Methods 说单晶由 Czochralski 拉晶所得，但具体拉速、转速、熔体气氛、原料纯度与成分梯度未在这篇正文详述，引用较早工作；不能按常见拉晶工艺补写。电阻采用四探针电流反转，4–300 K；DSC 用约 11.8 mg 晶体、10 K/min 在 200–450 K 扫描。室温高压同步辐射粉末衍射使用从晶体研碎的粉末，在 0–10 GPa、甲醇:乙醇=4:1 压力介质下测量。研粉后的压力结构与整晶电阻并非完全同一个测量对象。
papers.conclusion: PrIr₃B₂ 的两步金属—绝缘—金属异常伴随六方 P6/mmm 与单斜 C2/m 共存；降温到约 280 K 或室温加压到约 1.2 GPa 都能推向单斜相，10 K 的磁序又带出超区隙。结构与输运关联明确，电荷序仍只是可能解释。

sections.title: 科学问题
sections.text: PrIr₃B₂ 中电阻随温度呈两次金属—绝缘—金属变化，问题是这种异常是否有相应晶格变化。作者用温度、压力两种控制量追踪六方 P6/mmm 与单斜 C2/m 的竞争，并把 10 K 附近磁序纳入低温输运解释。相较于只看电阻曲线，衍射对称性与热分析是判断结构相变的独立证据；相反，电荷序仍未得到直接散射峰证实。

sections.title: 样品与实验设计
sections.text: Methods 说单晶由 Czochralski 拉晶所得，但具体拉速、转速、熔体气氛、原料纯度与成分梯度未在这篇正文详述，引用较早工作；不能按常见拉晶工艺补写。电阻采用四探针电流反转，4–300 K；DSC 用约 11.8 mg 晶体、10 K/min 在 200–450 K 扫描。室温高压同步辐射粉末衍射使用从晶体研碎的粉末，在 0–10 GPa、甲醇:乙醇=4:1 压力介质下测量。研粉后的压力结构与整晶电阻并非完全同一个测量对象。

sections.title: 证据分层
sections.text: 直接观察包括电阻双异常、热流峰、温度/压力依赖衍射峰的分裂及部分相共存；结构精修得出的相分数与空间群属于模型依赖量。约 280 K 或室温约 1.2 GPa 处出现单斜相的共性，支持“晶格自由度参与输运转变”的推断，却不足以宣布某个电子有序波矢。10 K 附近磁有序对低温能隙的解释还要和场依赖、晶体方向及可能杂质相比较。最弱点是缺少原位同一整晶在压力下的结构—电输运同步记录，也缺少拉晶棒位置的统计。

sections.title: 复现操作
sections.text: 按拉晶棒顶部、中部、底部编号，每段留一片做 Laue/单晶 XRD，一片四探针，一片 DSC；同炉保留 EDS/WDS 成分和杂相上限。先看正文 II 节仪器/压力介质，再读衍射图及 250/280 K 电阻异常，核对升降温是否有滞后。下一次压力实验加卸压回程与同批晶体结构检查；若双异常与初始双相分数相关，先控制生长成分和应力，再讨论电荷序。

readingGuide.first: 先看 II Methods 的 Czochralski 来源与 DSC/XRD 条件，再对 Fig.1 与压力回程衍射。
readingGuide.focus: 正文 Methods 明确采用四电极电流反转、4–300 K 电阻和 0–10 GPa 同步辐射粉末衍射，DSC 用约 11.8 mg 晶体、10 K/min 温扫。温压 XRD 使用研碎母晶，未等于原位同一整晶输运。压强介质为甲醇:乙醇 4:1。具体 Czochralski 拉速、气氛、收率仍需追溯引文。

papers.title: Varying A-site radius and size disorder to tune magnetic ordering in compositionally complex perovskite oxides
papers.authors: Geers, Madeleine, Dokala, Ravi Kiran, Mathieu, Roland, Clulow, Rebecca
papers.institutions: 作者单位见 arXiv 原文；本轮未逐一归一化机构名称

papers.abstract: A long standing goal of magnetochemists is to be able to control ordering temperatures through compositional engineering. Here we report the synthesis of a perovskite oxide with twelve cations accommodated within a single phase solid solution, AM7O$_3$, A = La$_{\frac{1}{5}}$Sm$_{\frac{1}{5}}$Gd$_{\frac{1}{5}}$Nd$_{\frac{1}{5}}$Dy$_{\frac{1}{5}}$ (A5), and M7 = Ti$_{\frac{1}{7}}$Cr$_{\frac{1}{7}}$Mn$_{\frac{1}{7}}$Fe$_{\frac{1}{7}}$Co$_{\frac{1}{7}}$Ni$_{\frac{1}{7}}$Cu$_{\frac{1}{7}}$. Bulk magnetometry measurements for A5M7O$_3$, as well as for A = La, Gd and La$_{\frac{1}{2}}$Gd$_{\frac{1}{2}}$, show that all these compounds magnetically order as ferrimagnets between 89 and 115 K. We find that the magnetic properties are influenced by considering a combination of the size disorder parameter alongside the A-site cationic radii and valence electrons.
papers.conclusion: 在单相钙钛矿中同时置入五种 A 位和七种过渡金属，目标是检验 A 位平均半径与尺寸无序如何改变磁序温度，而不能把名义混合直接当成微观均匀。

papers.title: Atomic-Scale Imaging of Lattice Relaxation and Topological Flat Bands in Helical Trilayer Graphene
papers.authors: Jiang, Shudan, Li, Zonglin, Gu, Yu, Liu, Liang, Guan, Dandan, Li, Yaoyi, Zheng, Hao, Liu, Canhua, Watanabe, Kenji, Taniguchi, Takashi, Jiang, Shengwei, Liu, Xiaoxue, Shi, Zhiwen, Chen, Guorui, Jia, Jinfeng, Li, Tingxin, Li, Can, Wang, Shiyong
papers.institutions: 作者单位见 arXiv 原文；本轮未逐一归一化机构名称
papers.access: 摘要级：本轮只核对 arXiv 官方摘要/元数据；制备与测量未在摘要给出的项目均为待核正文。
papers.abstract: Helical trilayer graphene (HTG) has emerged as a highly tunable moire quantum material that hosts strong electronic correlations and nontrivial band topology. However, the atomic-scale lattice structure and local electronic properties have remained largely unexplored. Here we present a comprehensive real-space study of HTG using a combination of scanning near-field optical microscopy and low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy. We directly image supermoire lattice relaxation, revealing large triangular domains separated by sharp domain walls, as well as stripe domains connected by smoothly varying boundaries. Atomic-scale spectroscopy uncovers flat bands with a honeycomb electronic texture and one-dimensional boundary states confined to domain walls. By systematically varying the twist angle, we identify a magic angle of approximately 1.9°, substantially larger than the 1.6 degree predicted by theory. Our results establish a direct microscopic link between lattice relaxation and flat bands in HTG.
papers.conclusion: 近场与 STM 在实空间看见超莫尔晶格弛豫、三角畴及其边界，把平带和拓扑响应连接到真实局域结构，而非只由平均扭角模型推断。

papers.title: Entropy-Driven Altermagnetism from Thermal Magnons
papers.authors: Halder, Tanaya, Nandy, Ashis K., Mukherjee, Anamitra
papers.institutions: 作者单位见 arXiv 原文；本轮未逐一归一化机构名称
papers.access: 摘要级：本轮只核对 arXiv 官方摘要/元数据；制备与测量未在摘要给出的项目均为待核正文。
papers.abstract: We identify a route to altermagnetism driven by entropy upon heating and demonstrate it in a minimal square-lattice antiferromagnet. An exchange modulation is entropically favored because the resulting momentum-dependent magnon splitting increases the magnon entropy, thereby lowering the free energy and favoring altermagnetism. We derive an instability criterion for this exchange-modulated state, predict its temperature-driven reentrant behavior, and show that its overlap with Néel order defines a finite-temperature altermagnetic phase. Variational spin-wave theory, spin--lattice Monte Carlo, and cluster diagonalization establish the entropy-driven instability and its coexistence with magnetic order. The resulting state supports a transverse spin conductivity. The mechanism provides a route to thermally induced altermagnetism in compensated magnets coupled to sufficiently soft physical modes.
papers.conclusion: 该理论提出升温后磁振子熵可偏好动量依赖的自旋劈裂，从而使交替磁序反常地由热涨落稳定，并预言再入行为。

papers.method: 超流刚度与动感电感理论
papers.abstract: Superconductor and two-dimensional hole gas heterostructures are promising platforms for quantum devices, but their intrinsic properties, e.g., unconventional pairings, are hard to access experimentally. Here, we show that the in-plane-field dependence of the superfluid stiffness and spin susceptibility exhibits nonanalyticities encoding the induced gap structure in the hole gas. Additionally, Fourier harmonics of the stiffness tensor's field-angle dependence, accessible via kinetic-inductance measurements, provide fingerprints of unconventional pairing and cubic Rashba coupling.
papers.conclusion: 面内场改变超流刚度和自旋磁化率的非解析性，可用动感电感角向谐波区分诱导配对结构。

papers.method: 背栅多层 WS₂；20 mK 输运
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional materials are promising candidates for electronic applications beyond the operating limits of conventional semiconductor technologies. Within this class, transition-metal dichalcogenides offer attractive properties for field-effect transistor operation, with tungsten disulphide (WS$_2$) emerging as a particularly promising material for operation at cryogenic temperatures. Here, we investigate the electrical performance of a back-gated multilayer WS$_2$ transistor at deep cryogenic temperature, down to 20 mK. The device remains strongly gate-tunable throughout the cryogenic regime, with an effective on/off current ratio exceeding $10^{5}$. Most notably, the low-temperature turn-on characteristics exhibit reproducible shoulder-like features, which we describe using a phenomenological model comprising multiple effective conduction branches operating in parallel.
papers.conclusion: 多层 WS₂ 背栅晶体管在深低温仍可调控，出现多个输运分支，提示低温器件评估不能只看室温迁移率。

papers.title: Optical observation of interlayer spin correlation
papers.authors: Park, Akiyoshi, Upadhyay, Pranshoo, Grankin, Andrey, Boström, Emil Viñas, Ghafariasl, Mahdi, Alnatah, Hassan, Mohammadi-Arzanagh, Masoud, Nambiar, Gautam, Gao, Beini, Alvandi, Alireza, Kumar, Sakthi Rajmano Madhan, Alshalan, Ghadah, Sherwood, Isaac, Mehrabad, Mahmoud Jalali, Zhou, You, Ramanathan, Arun, Roy, Xavier, Rubio, Angel, Hafezi, Mohammad
papers.institutions: 作者单位见 arXiv 原文；本轮未逐一归一化机构名称
papers.access: 摘要级：本轮只核对 arXiv 官方摘要/元数据；制备与测量未在摘要给出的项目均为待核正文。
papers.method: 光学探测层间自旋关联
papers.abstract: Spin correlations govern numerous collective behaviors of quantum materials, underpinning exotic phenomena such as unconventional superconductivity and topological magnetism. In layered materials, the interlayer spin correlation is important because it characterizes the magnetic ground state and determines spin transport across the interface. Yet interlayer spin correlations have remained hard to measure directly, leaving one of the most basic quantities of two-dimensional magnetism out of experimental reach. Here we provide the first direct optical probe of interlayer spin correlations, using two-magnon Raman scattering in the van der Waals antiferromagnet (AFM) CrSBr, in remarkable agreement with a microscopic spin-wave model without any fitting parameter. Moreover, the two-magnon channel switches on only in the AFM state and vanishes when a magnetic field takes the crystal to a ferromagnetic state. We furthermore establish an exciton-mediated variant of the technique, where tuning the laser near the exciton resonance enhances the signal roughly tenfold due to the exciton's large oscillator strength. Magnon-pair Raman spectroscopy thus opens a direct optical window into interlayer spin correlations in van der Waals magnets, extendable to twisted bilayers and proximity-coupled heterostructures.
papers.conclusion: 提出对层间自旋关联的光学直接读出，弥补以往从总磁化或输运间接猜测层间序的缺口。

papers.title: Nature of the 175-180 cm$^{-1}$ Raman Feature in Altermagnetic $\alpha$-MnTe
papers.authors: Bhardwaj, Pankaj, Sarkar, Rajib, Shyaga, Naresh, Negi, Subhransu Kumar, Biswas, Kartick, Jana, Susmita, Nukala, Pavan, Nanda, B. R. K., Suri, Dhavala
papers.institutions: 作者单位见 arXiv 原文；本轮未逐一归一化机构名称
papers.access: 全文精读：已读公开 HTML 的正文与实验段；未另取补充材料。
papers.abstract: The 175 cm$^{-1}$ Raman mode in $\alpha$-MnTe has long been assigned to the material's only symmetry-allowed phonon ($E_{2g}$), yet first-principles calculations consistently place this mode below 100 cm$^{-1}$. Recent works have offered three competing explanations for the discrepancy: a weak symmetry-lowering ($D_{6h}\rightarrow D_{3h}$) phonon, an electronic plasmon arising from intrinsic hole self-doping, or an extrinsic MnTe$_2$ impurity signature. Here we resolve this controversy using stoichiometry-controlled molecular beam epitaxy (MBE). We deliberately vary the fraction of pyrite-type MnTe$_2$ secondary phase relative to the $\alpha$-MnTe matrix. Across this series, the 175 cm$^{-1}$ mode tracks the presence of MnTe$_2$ essentially one-to-one -- present wherever MnTe$_2$ is detectable, absent in stoichiometric, single-phase $\alpha$-MnTe at nominal LASER powers. When LASER power is ramped up, an additional mode emerges in MnTe as well positioned close to $\approx$ 175 cm$^{-1}$; our detailed temperatures dependendent Raman analysis identifies the LASER power scorched region close to a distorted MnTe phase, confirmed via transmission electron microscopy. This direct, growth-controlled correlation identifies the mode as an extrinsic MnTe$_2$ impurity signature or as a distorted MnTe feature, rather than an intrinsic phonon or plasmon feature, providing a practical diagnostic for phase purity in MBE-grown $\alpha$-MnTe and clarifying which Raman features can be reliably attributed to the intrinsic altermagnetic phase.
papers.conclusion: 175–180 cm⁻¹ Raman 峰并非可随意称作 α-MnTe 本征 E₂g：在常规激光功率下该峰随 MnTe₂ 杂相出现，单相 α-MnTe 中消失；把激光功率提高后，受灼伤的畸变 MnTe 区域也会出现邻近峰。

papers.title: Three-Dimensional Topology from Stacking-Controlled Umklapp Scattering in Large-Angle Twisted Graphite
papers.authors: Li, Juncheng, Chen, Cong, Yao, Wang
papers.institutions: 作者单位见 arXiv 原文；本轮未逐一归一化机构名称
papers.access: 摘要级：本轮只核对 arXiv 官方摘要/元数据；制备与测量未在摘要给出的项目均为待核正文。
papers.abstract: Large-angle twisted graphene lies beyond the local-stacking description of conventional moiré systems: inequivalent rotation centers define distinct commensurate interfaces whose low-energy interlayer hybridization is governed by intervalley Umklapp tunneling. For three-dimensional twisted graphite assembled from interfaces with different crystalline symmetries, a symmetry-constrained effective model reveals that competition between nonchiral and chiral tunneling produces one-ring and two-ring nodal-line phases and a $C_3$-protected higher-order topological insulator in the presence of sublattice (chiral) symmetry. The nodal rings carry integer winding numbers, allowing oppositely wound rings to annihilate into the gapped phase. We further examine how sublattice-symmetry breaking modifies these phases. Density functional theory (DFT) and atomistic calculations for $21.8^\circ$ twisted graphite identify the equilibrium structure as a higher-order topological insulator, while compression drives it into a topological Weyl semimetal phase. These findings establish the stacking sequence of symmetry-inequivalent interfaces as a means of engineering band topology in three-dimensional twisted structures.
papers.conclusion: 大角度扭转界面的谷间 Umklapp 让堆垛中心成为真正的拓扑控制量，理论产生单环/双环节线与高阶拓扑区。
